purpose: Xianxia/cultivation trend research for XIANYX production pipeline
sources: TikTok: New Chinese Short Dramas 2026 (8.1M posts)
TikTok: Chinese Historical Drama April 2026 (7.6M posts)

trending.topic: Xianxia Short Drama — Episode Cliffhanger Format
trending.trend_note: Short drama format (5-8 episodes per arc) is exploding on TikTok. 8.1M+ posts for 'new Chinese short dramas 2026'. Cliffhanger per-episode format drives repeat views and follows.
trending.caption_hook: He never expected to be reborn with this gift... Episode {N}

trending.trend_note: Rebirth/regression story arcs are the #1 traffic driver in xianxia webnovels. Audience already primed for 'he died and came back stronger' narratives. XIANYX-01 (Trieu Tien) uses this exact arc.
trending.seo_title_template: He Died {X} Times Before He Understood | {Episode Title}
trending.caption_hook: He died 500 times to become immortal... but by life 500, he forgot what it meant to be human.

trending.trend_note: 'Overpowered Legends' compilation YouTube Shorts are going viral (6 days ago, trending). OP protagonist is the most-clipped xianxia format. Good for compilation clips strategy alongside original episodes.
trending.seo_title_template: The Moment He Became UNSTOPPABLE | {Series Name} Compilation
trending.caption_hook: The scene where he stops hiding his true power.

trending.trend_note: Regular list/ranking content ('Top 5 Xianxia Webnovels of 2026' — 114 likes, Mar 15 2026) is evergreen and low competition. XIANYX series can cross-promote with list content.
trending.caption_hook: You won't believe #1. These cultivation novels will consume your entire year.

trending.topic: Top 10 Cultivation Donghua 2026 — Animated Adaptation Hype
trending.trend_note: Bilibili's 'Immortality 5' donghua episode 15 has 58K views. '10 New Cultivation Donghua of 2026 Worth Watching NOW' (Feb 2) is trending. Cross-pollination opportunity between donghua fans and short drama fans.
trending.caption_hook: The cultivation donghua taking anime fans by storm in 2026.

trending.topic: Xianxia Soundtrack / Audio — Epic Cultivation Music Trend
trending.trend_note: Original Chinese drama OSTs (soundtracks) are a separate viral category on TikTok. 'Immortal cultivation music' aesthetic videos are popular. XIANYX can use trending audio alongside video.
trending.seo_title_template: {Series Name} OST | The Moment His Power Awakens
trending.caption_hook: This is the soundtrack for every xianxia protagonist's awakening moment.

trending.topic: Chinese Historical Drama April 2026 — New Season Drop
trending.trend_note: 7.6M+ posts for 'Chinese Historical Drama April 2026'. April 2026 has multiple new Chinese drama drops. Peak season for xianxia/cultivation content discovery. XIANYX episodes should release now to ride the wave.
trending.caption_hook: New episode just dropped. The cultivation world will never be the same.

trending.topic: POV: You Are a Cultivator / Immortal POV Series
trending.trend_note: POV format ('POV: you become a cultivator') is highly engaging on TikTok. POV text overlays on XIANYX clips can significantly boost reach. Good for hooks and teaser trailers.
trending.seo_title_template: POV: You Just Awakened Your {Power Type} | Xianxia
trending.caption_hook: POV: you just broke through to the next realm. Nobody noticed... yet.

trending.trend_note: Female cultivator / villainess-rebirth arcs are a massive subgenre. Strong crossover with romance xianxia audience. XIANYX series should feature female cultivator characters prominently in thumbnails and hooks.
trending.seo_title_template: She Was Called Weak. Then She Awakened. | {Series Name}
trending.caption_hook: The villainess everyone mocked... until her next breakthrough.

trending.trend_note: Explainer content ('what is cultivation?', 'cultivation realm system explained') is low competition and evergreen. Great companion content for viewers new to the genre. Boosts channel authority and watch time.
trending.seo_title_template: Xianxia Cultivation Explained in {N} Minutes | Realm System Guide
trending.caption_hook: Qi Condensation. Golden Core. Nascent Soul. What's the REAL strongest realm?

seo_notes.title_format: Episode {N} — {Emotion Word} | {Series Title} | Xianxia Short Drama
seo_notes.description_template: Episode {N} of {Series Name}. {1-sentence cliffhanger hook}. Follow for new episodes of {Series Name} — the xianxia cultivation series everyone is talking about. #xianxia #cultivation #chinesedrama #wuxia #fantasy
seo_notes.tiktok_caption_length: Under 150 chars for hook, then 3-5 hashtags, then 2-3 niche tags
seo_notes.posting_frequency: 1-2 episodes per day minimum, 3 if production allows — drama drop season
